name: AI Hustle
conditions: Third-party directory listings describe AI Hustle as 'free submission, with optional paid placement' and note the free queue is long while paid fast-tracks review.
The site's /submit/ page exists but rendered only the Ghost CMS chrome (title 'Submit AI tool') with no visible form to a plain fetch — the submission mechanism could not be verified firsthand.
requirements: AI tools only — the directory is organized by AI tool tags (image, video, voice, writing, SEO, marketing, AI agent, vibe coding, NSFW AI, etc.).
Third-party source states no badge is required.
preparation: Category fit from their tag list (e.g. /tag/ai-agent/, /tag/seo/).
Possibly an account: the site runs Ghost with Sign up / Sign in / Subscribe portal links.
workflow: Open https://aihustle.tools/submit/ — the page is titled 'Submit AI tool' but the body content did not render to a plain fetcher; a browser may be required.
If no form is visible, sign up / sign in via the Ghost portal (/#/portal/) or contact via the site's listed channels.
Third-party guidance: free submission queue is long; a paid fast-track option exists.
watchFor: Submit page body is empty/members-only on a plain fetch — verify in a real browser before assuming a self-serve form exists.
Ghost portal subscribe/signup modals may intercept the flow.
Third-party claims (dofollow, DR 38, no badge, freemium cost) are not confirmed on the site itself.
countsAsLive: A dedicated tool page under aihustle.tools (e.g. /aitools/<slug> or a tagged listing) is publicly reachable and linked from the AI Tools index.
unknowns: Whether /submit/ contains a real form or requires a paid Ghost membership.
Exact price of the paid fast-track placement.
Whether a reciprocal link or account is truly required.
